About

Xavier Shakur was born and raised in Lawton, Oklahoma. After graduating high school, he briefly attended the University of Central Oklahoma, where he began performing stand-up comedy in 2016.

After leaving the university, Xavier enlisted in the United States Air Force. From 2017 to 2023, he served as an airborne cryptologic language analyst.

In 2020, Xavier began organizing politically. Since then, his work has continued to develop across comedy, political organizing, cultural commentary, and other creative mediums.

Presently, Xavier is creating — and fighting the good fight — through whatever medium he deems best suited to the moment.
